title: Loaded Potato Soup with {p}
steps: Cook the {p} until {doneness}, then move to a plate. Keep a spoonful of the fat in the pot.
Soften the {v} with the {spice} in the pot, about 5 minutes. Add the diced {s} and 3 cups of broth or water.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes, until a fork slides into the pieces easily. Mash some of the potato right in the pot for a thicker soup.
Stir in the {sauce}, warm through, and top with the {p}.
tip: Mash more of the potato and use milk in place of cream for a lighter, still creamy soup.
